title: Skin booster injections (hyaluronic acid)
what: The doctor makes many tiny injections of hyaluronic acid into the skin. It moisturizes the skin from within.
why: When the skin is dry, dull, with fine lines, after sun exposure, or before an important event.
duration: a session usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; a course is usually several sessions, and the effect shows after a few days
tell_doctor: If you are pregnant or breastfeeding
If you get cold sores on your lips
If you recently had a facial cleaning, a peel, or other injections

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 1 to 2 days before, better no alcohol or sauna.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: If your face is inflamed or you have a cold sore, the procedure is usually postponed.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take, and they will decide.

bring: A list of your medicines, if you take any regularly
steps: A numbing cream is applied, and you wait for it to work
Your skin is wiped with an antiseptic
The doctor makes many tiny injections with a thin needle
At the end, a soothing product is applied
feel: Tingling and burning during the injections
Afterward, small bumps on the skin that usually go away in 1 to 2 days
after: Do not touch your face with your hands on the first day
Usually 1 to 2 days with no makeup, sauna, pool, or sport
Come for the next session at the time your doctor sets
red_flags: Heavy swelling, pain, and redness that grow on day 2 to 3
Small pimples with pus, or hot skin at the injection sites
Swelling of the face or lips, or trouble breathing: call emergency services

faq.q: How long do the bumps last?
faq.a: Usually 1 to 2 days. If they last longer, show them to your doctor.
It is usually bearable, since a numbing cream is applied first.

reminders.text: Skin booster session tomorrow. No alcohol or sauna today. Come without makeup if you can.
